name: Dranik Heartlands: Encampments
summary: Fortified Muramite encampments spread across the Heartlands, serving as command posts and staging grounds.
description: The Encampments are heavily fortified Muramite positions scattered across the Dranik Heartlands. These camps serve as command posts, supply hubs, beast‑handler yards, and troop staging grounds. Muramite officers direct operations from command tents, while legionnaires patrol the perimeter. Dragorn resistance fighters frequently attempt infiltration, sabotage, and supply disruption. Discord energy bleeds into the area, warping wildlife and destabilizing structures.
